glosses: plant (factory or industrial facility), especially a large one
power plant (industrial complex where electricity is produced)

examples.text: Foi preciso muito tempo e dinheiro para construir esta usina.
examples.en: It took a long time and a lot of money to build this factory.

examples.text: Era a primeira usina de dessalinização do mundo movida a energia solar.
examples.en: It was the world's first solar-powered desalination plant.
